description: This file contains the definition of the EchoSqlLogger class, a utility class that implements the Doctrine DBAL SQLLogger interface to log SQL queries, parameters, and types, primarily for debugging purposes in the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: EchoSqlLogger
classes.description: A logger class that outputs executed SQL statements and associated parameters and types for debugging.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the logger with an optional flag to replace existing output (though not utilized in this implementation).

methods.name: startQuery
methods.description: Logs the SQL statement, parameters, and types when a query starts execution.

methods.name: stopQuery
methods.description: A no-operation method to satisfy the SQLLogger interface; does nothing when a query stops.
